EUR/USD looking oversold on daily chart. Expecting bounce from 1.04 support. Good risk/reward for long position.

items.title: Gold prices surge amid uncertainty
items.content: Gold hit $2400/oz this morning. Geopolitical tensions driving safe haven demand. Silver also climbing.

items.title: Oil Prices Fall on Demand Concerns
items.content: Crude oil drops 3% on fears of economic slowdown. OPEC+ production cut not enough to offset weak demand outlook.
